description.value: Wingate by Wyndham Kamloops is a mid-scale Wyndham-brand hotel situated on Rogers Way in Kamloops, a city that sits at the confluence of the North and South Thompson Rivers and is a common overnight stop on the TransCanada touring route. As part of the Wingate chain, the property targets business and leisure travellers with extended-stay-style amenities. Its location on the eastern edge of the city provides reasonable access to the Trans-Canada corridor.
